subject: The 2AM text that saved her marriage
preview_text: She scanned a conversation with her husband. The result? Not what she expected.
body_paragraphs: A user named Jenna scanned a conversation with her husband at 2AM. She was sure she'd find red flags - gaslighting, manipulation, something. But the app told her something else: zero toxicity, high emotional safety.

She wrote me, 'I was ready to leave. But seeing the truth in black and white stopped me. We're in therapy now, working on us.' I never expected anyone to use Red Flag Scanner AI to confirm things were actually fine. But Jenna used it to trust her gut - and it saved her marriage.

This is the pattern scanner you probably haven't tried: scan a random conversation with someone you trust. Not to find danger - to confirm safety. It's called 'baseline checking.' You open the app, screenshot a calm chat, and let AI tell you if your radar is off.

Try it right now. Open the app, scan any conversation from this week - even a boring one. The CTA below takes you straight to the scanner. P.S. One user scanned her mom's texts and found she was gaslighting her for years. Sometimes the red flag is closer than you think.
